_comment: Sidecar metadata for the local custom SVG icons in this directory. Keyed by icon name = the SVG filename without its .svg extension (cursor-ai.svg -> 'cursor-ai' -> usr-cursor-ai in glyphs.json; the 'usr-' namespace marks these as your own, distinct from FA 7's 'fa-*'). Every field is optional; anything omitted falls back to a value derived from the file name. Each field maps 1:1 to a column in the final symbols DB. Recognised fields: 'label' (human title -> the symbol's `name`), 'keywords' (fuzzy-search terms -> `keywords`), 'shortcode' (the SINGLE primary shortcode, rendered :like-this: -> the `shortcode` column), 'aliases' (the EXTRA shortcodes, also :like-this: -> `extra_shortcodes`), 'description' (a rich, human-written sentence -> the rich-only `description` column), and 'code' (hex codepoint to PIN this icon to, e.g. "10fb00", so it stays put across rebuilds and is safe to hard-code in a TUI). Without 'code' the icon is auto-assigned from CUSTOM_START (0x10fb00+) in sorted-filename order, which can shift when files are added/renamed. Pin codepoints in the custom block (>= 0x10fb00, <= 0x10fffd); avoid the relocated FA range (0x100000..0x10f8ff). Keys starting with _ or $ are ignored, so this header is safe. An 'icons' wrapper object is also accepted if you prefer.

cursor-ai.label: Cursor
cursor-ai.description: Cursor (the AI code editor) brand cube logo

layout_panel_up.label: Top Panel
layout_panel_up.description: Icon to represent a split panel on top of the screen
